Task Board (Kanban)

  Kanban-style task board with columns mapping to kspec task states.
  Active Fleet row shows currently running agent work with live output.
  Task cards show key metadata, clicking opens detail modal.

Acceptance Criteria:
  [ac-1]
    Given: Tasks in various states

    When: The task board renders

    Then: Tasks are distributed into columns: Backlog (pending, manual_only/unassessed),
Ready (pending, eligible), In Progress (in_progress, needs_work),
Review (pending_review), Done (completed recent), with blocked and cancelled
handled as sections/indicators

    Given: A task card on the board

    When: The card renders

    Then: It shows priority badge, tag chips, title, slug (mono), spec ref link,

    Given: A task card

    When: The user clicks it

    Then: A detail modal opens showing full task info: title, description, status,

automation status, VCS info (branch, PR link), plan ref, session link

    Given: Agents actively working on tasks (dispatch running)

    When: The task board renders

    Then: An Active Fleet row appears at the top showing cards with task title,
agent name, elapsed time with pulse indicator, and last few lines of output

  [ac-5]
    Given: The task board with WebSocket connected

    When: A task state changes

    Then: The board updates in real-time without page refresh

  [ac-6]
    Given: The task detail modal in daemon mode

    When: The user clicks action buttons (Start, Submit, Complete, Block, Add Note)

    Then: The corresponding task transition or mutation is executed via API
